meta.description: Flake-owned static base for the nono 'work' profile (PLAN.md Phase 3). NOT launch-ready on its own: __APPROVAL_WEBHOOK_URL__ must be substituted, and scripts/gen-profile.sh must merge in the per-launch closure/workdir/add/clone filesystem grants before this is passed to `nono run --profile`.

This 'allow' shape is a best-effort guess, modelled on the allow_domain/allow_origins list shape used elsewhere in this same file; it may not be the field nono actually expects.
